data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Android app update checks and installation using XUpdate library.
data.what_it_does: Provides initialization, version check, custom JSON parsing, and update UI for Android apps. Supports silent install, auto mode, and customizable dialogs.
use_when: You need in‑app update functionality on Android only
You want a ready‑made UI for prompting users to download a new APK
avoid_when: Your app targets iOS or other platforms
strengths: Supports silent install and auto mode
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, call FlutterXUpdate.init on Android, ensure required Android permissions for storage and install unknown apps
